assignmentHtml.task:
核查关于露西号（Lucy）的主张D1和D2。

起点：https://science.nasa.gov/mission/lucy/

关键问题：

  1. 露西号是否在2023年11月与Dinkinesh交会？这是否为露西号首次抵达木星特洛伊小行星？
  2. 接触双星结构属于主星Dinkinesh，还是其卫星Selam？
  3. 与Donaldjohanson和Dinkinesh的交会是否属于对露西号未来特洛伊目标的观测？
  4. 露西号造访哪些目标群体（主带小行星与木星特洛伊小行星）？区分已完成的交会和计划中的交会。

查找露西号任务页面及论文发表详情。
assignmentHtml.context: 任务：露西号（Lucy）。目标：主带小行星（Dinkinesh、Selam、Donaldjohanson）以及木星特洛伊小行星（Patroclus/Menoetius、11789等）。主张D1—D2：D1称2023年11月与Dinkinesh的交会是露西号首次抵达木星特洛伊小行星，且接触双星结构属于主星Dinkinesh，而非卫星Selam。D2称这些观测很有用，但对这些目标的观测并非对未来特洛伊目标的观测，且时间线应区分不同目标群体。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 对D1和D2的每个组成部分给出判定，附修正后的文本、日期、目标身份和来源URL。阐明哪个天体具有接触双星结构、Dinkinesh是特洛伊小行星还是主带小行星，以及露西号完整的交会时间表。

answerHtml:
Both D1 and D2 contain significant errors requiring correction.

D1 Claim 1 — 'Nov 2023 encounter with Dinkinesh was Lucy's first Jupiter Trojan arrival': FALSE. Dinkinesh is a main-belt asteroid, not a Jupiter Trojan. The Nov 1, 2023 flyby was Lucy's first-ever asteroid encounter (any population), but its first Jupiter Trojan encounter was Eurybates on Aug 12, 2027.

D1 Claim 2 — 'contact-binary structure belongs to primary Dinkinesh': FALSE. The contact-binary structure belongs to Selam, the satellite of Dinkinesh. NASA states: 'the mission team was surprised to discover that Selam is a contact binary… It's the first contact binary discovered orbiting an asteroid.' Each lobe of Selam is ~220 m; Dinkinesh itself is ~790 m across and is not a contact binary.

D2 Claim 1 — 'Donaldjohanson and Dinkinesh encounters are observations of Lucy's future Trojan targets': FALSE. Both are main-belt asteroids, a distinct target population from Jupiter Trojans. NASA states they are 'not a primary science target' but rather in-flight demonstrations to practice encounter capabilities and reduce mission risk before the Trojan encounters. They serve as testbeds, not Trojan observations.

D2 Claim 2 — 'timeline should distinguish target populations': TRUE. Lucy has two clearly distinct populations: main-belt (practice targets) and Jupiter Trojans (primary science targets).

Corrected encounter schedule:
MAIN BELT (practice targets):

  • (152830) Dinkinesh + satellite Selam — Nov 1, 2023 [COMPLETED]
  • (52246) Donaldjohanson — Apr 20, 2025 [COMPLETED]

JUPITER TROJANS (primary targets):

  • (3548) Eurybates + satellite Queta (L4, C-type) — Aug 12, 2027 [PLANNED]
  • (15094) Polymele + unnamed satellite (L4, P-type) — Sep 15, 2027 [PLANNED]
  • (11351) Leucus (L4, D-type) — Apr 18, 2028 [PLANNED]
  • (21900) Orus (L4, D/C-type) — Nov 11, 2028 [PLANNED]
  • (617) Patroclus + Menoetius binary (L5, P-types) — Mar 2–3, 2033 [PLANNED]

evidence.snippet: Paraphrase: NASA's Lucy mission page lists Dinkinesh+Selam under 'Lucy's Main Belt Asteroids' (Nov 1, 2023) and Eurybates+Queta under 'Lucy's Trojan Asteroids' (Aug 11, 2027). The page states: 'Lucy will explore a record-breaking number of asteroids, flying by three asteroids in the solar system's main asteroid belt, and by eight Trojan asteroids.' The first Trojan flyby is Aug 11, 2027 — not Nov 2023.
evidence.supports: Dinkinesh is a main-belt asteroid; first Trojan encounter is Aug 2027, not Nov 2023

evidence.snippet: Paraphrase: 'Dinkinesh is a small asteroid located in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.' Regarding the contact binary: 'As Lucy continued to return data, the mission team was surprised to discover that Selam is a contact binary. In other words, it is made of two smaller objects touching each other. It's the first contact binary discovered orbiting an asteroid.'
evidence.supports: Dinkinesh is main-belt, not Trojan; contact-binary structure belongs to satellite Selam, not primary Dinkinesh

evidence.snippet: Paraphrase: Peer-reviewed paper (Levison et al. 2025): 'In addition, Lucy will visit two main-belt asteroids, (152830)Dinkinesh and (52246)Donaldjohanson, in order to practice its encounters.' Trojan encounters listed: Eurybates+Queta Aug 12 2027, Polymele Sep 15 2027, Leucus Apr 18 2028, Orus Nov 11 2028, Patroclus-Menoetius Mar 2 2033. 'Lucy uses two Earth gravity assists… to reach Jupiter's L4 Trojan swarm. On its way to the Trojans the spacecraft intercepts two main-belt asteroids, which are used as in-flight demonstrations of the spacecraft's capability and to reduce mission risk prior to the Trojan encounters.'
evidence.supports: Main-belt encounters are practice targets, not observations of Trojan targets; full Trojan schedule begins Aug 2027

evidence.snippet: Paraphrase: 'Asteroid Donaldjohanson is a uniquely shaped fragment of an asteroid… It is located in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.' Also: 'Like Lucy's first asteroid flyby target, Dinkinesh, Donaldjohanson is not a primary science target of the Lucy mission.'
evidence.supports: Donaldjohanson is a main-belt asteroid, not a Trojan; explicitly described as not a primary science target

evidence.snippet: Paraphrase: Complete timeline confirms: Nov 1, 2023 Dinkinesh (main belt); Apr 20, 2025 Donaldjohanson (main belt); Aug 12, 2027 Eurybates (Trojan); Sep 15, 2027 Polymele (Trojan); Apr 18, 2028 Leucus (Trojan); Nov 11, 2028 Orus (Trojan); Mar 3, 2033 Patroclus-Menoetius (Trojan).
evidence.supports: Full encounter schedule distinguishing main-belt vs Trojan populations; first Trojan is Aug 2027
